Sets the camera clock whenever the phone connects to the camera\'s Wi-Fi. Starts with the phone.
When the camera\'s Wi-Fi is on, the phone joins it, sets the clock and goes back to its usual Wi-Fi. Checked when you unlock the phone and every 3 minutes while the screen is on.
The phone joins the camera\'s Wi-Fi by itself when it is on and no other saved Wi-Fi is in range. Sync now switches to the camera from any Wi-Fi.
Allowed. The phone will not stop the app to save battery.
Not allowed yet. The phone may stop the app, and then the camera is not synced.
On. The app starts by itself after the phone restarts.
%1$s phones also need Auto-start switched on for this app.
Make sure OM Time is switched on in %1$s\'s auto-start settings.
On the next screen, open Battery and choose Unrestricted, or turn off the background restriction.
%1$s phones block apps from starting with the phone until you allow it. On the next screen, find OM Time and switch it on.
On the next screen, set OM Time to No restrictions (it may be called Unrestricted, or Never sleeping apps).

1. Allow everything the app asks for: notifications, running in the background and, on some phones, auto-start.
2. On the camera, start Wi-Fi (Connection to Smartphone). It shows a network name and password.
3. Tap Find camera, pick the camera's network and type the password. Find camera lists only Olympus and OM System cameras; if yours is missing, use Type in. If the phone asks whether to connect to the device, allow it.
4. Done. Whenever the camera's Wi-Fi is on, the phone connects and sets the clock from the phone's time and time zone.
